name: 30 Day Sales Spread
query:
WITH RECURSIVE date_list AS (
    SELECT CURDATE() AS `date`
    UNION ALL
    SELECT DATE_SUB(`date`, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
    FROM date_list
    WHERE `date` > DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 29 DAY)
)
SELECT
    date_list.`date` AS "Date:Date:150",
    ROUND(SUM(CASE
        WHEN b.`restaurant_table` IS NOT NULL AND b.`order_type` != "Take Away" AND b.`customer_group` != "Aggregators" THEN b.`grand_total`
        ELSE 0
    END), 2) AS "Dine In:Currency:100",
    ROUND(SUM(CASE
        WHEN b.`customer_group` != "Aggregators" THEN
            CASE
                WHEN b.`restaurant_table` IS NULL THEN
                    CASE
                        WHEN b.`order_type` = "Take Away" THEN b.`grand_total`
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ELSE 0
            END
        ELSE 0
    END), 2) AS "Take Away:Currency:100",
    ROUND(SUM(CASE
        WHEN b.`customer_group` != "Aggregators" THEN
            CASE
                WHEN b.`restaurant_table` IS NOT NULL THEN
                    CASE
                        WHEN b.`order_type` = "Take Away" THEN b.`grand_total`
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ELSE 0
            END
        ELSE 0
    END), 2) AS "Table Take Away:Currency:100",
    ROUND(SUM(CASE
        WHEN b.`customer_group` = "Aggregators" THEN b.`grand_total`
        ELSE 0
    END), 2) AS "Online:Currency:100",
    ROUND(SUM(CASE
        WHEN b.`customer_group` != "Aggregators" THEN
            CASE
                WHEN b.`restaurant_table` IS NULL THEN
                    CASE
                        WHEN b.`order_type` = "Delivery" THEN b.`grand_total`
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ELSE 0
            END
        ELSE 0
    END), 2) AS "Delivery:Currency:100"
FROM 
    date_list
    LEFT JOIN `tabPOS Invoice` b ON (
        b.`branch` = %(branch)s
        AND b.`status` IN ("Consolidated", "Paid") 
        AND b.`docstatus` = 1
        AND TIMESTAMP(b.`posting_date`, b.`posting_time`) >= TIMESTAMP(date_list.`date`, '05:02:00')
        AND TIMESTAMP(b.`posting_date`, b.`posting_time`) <= TIMESTAMP(DATE_ADD(date_list.`date`, INTERVAL 1 DAY), '05:00:00')
    )
    LEFT JOIN `tabURY Report Settings` rs ON (
    rs.`branch` = %(branch)s
    )
WHERE
    b.`grand_total` IS NOT NULL
    AND (
        ((rs.`hours` IS NULL OR rs.`hours` = 0) AND b.`posting_date` = date_list.`date`)
        OR (rs.`hours` > 0 AND TIMESTAMP(b.`posting_date`, b.`posting_time`) <= TIMESTAMP(DATE_ADD(date_list.`date`, INTERVAL 1 DAY), CONCAT(LPAD(rs.`hours`, 2, '0'), ':00:00')) AND TIMESTAMP(b.`posting_date`, b.`posting_time`) >= TIMESTAMP(date_list.`date`, CONCAT(LPAD(rs.`hours`, 2, '0'), ':00:00')))
        OR (rs.`branch` IS NULL AND b.`posting_date` = date_list.`date`)
    )
GROUP BY 
    date_list.`date`
ORDER BY 
    date_list.`date` ASC
